proves.claim: With claim.checkCeiling on, add --check writes a pending baseline carrying strict true.

cli.io-commands-add.strict-baseline-on.why: Without it, a new check would be filed non-strict and its ceiling would never bind.

proves.claim: With claim.checkCeiling off, the pending baseline of add --check has no strict field.

cli.io-commands-add.strict-baseline-off.why: Without it, the setting off could still mark checks strict.

proves.claim: With claim.checkCeiling on, edit --check with a new command writes a pending baseline carrying strict true.

cli.io-commands-edit.strict-baseline-on.why: Without it, an edited check would stay non-strict and its ceiling would never bind.

proves.claim: With claim.checkCeiling off, edit --check writes a baseline with no strict field.

cli.io-commands-edit.strict-baseline-off.why: Without it, the setting off could still mark edited checks strict.
